feed_summary: Low-privilege database accounts that cannot read a single application table can still be used to run code on the database server itself, a researcher has shown, by reaching memory-corruption bugs in the engine code behind ordinary SQL. title: Researcher Demonstrates Database RCE Exploits Affecting PostgreSQL, MySQL and Oracle
